body:
This isn't the correct way to do it, as this will cause *any* saved PNG image to be using fast compression when running with `--write-movie`, even if it's the user calling `Image.save_png()` in a script for reasons not related to writing movies.

Instead, I would add a flag like you did in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/117943, but don't expose it to scripting by exposing a separate method that doesn't take the flag parameter. The "real", non-exposed method would have an underscore prepended to it, and the exposed method always calls it with fast compression set to `false`.

Tested locally, it works as expected. Code looks good to me.

Using an optimized editor build with `production=yes lto=full`, and https://github.com/Calinou/godot-movie-maker-demo at 1280×720.

### `master`

```
Done recording movie at path: /tmp/input.png
1800 frames at 60 FPS (movie length: 00:00:30:00), recorded in 00:02:21 (21% of real-time speed).
CPU render time: 0.48 seconds (average: 0.27 ms/frame)
GPU render time: 21.32 seconds (average: 11.84 ms/frame)
Encoding time: 113.03 seconds (average: 62.79 ms/frame)
```

### This PR

```
Done recording movie at path: /tmp/input.png
1800 frames at 60 FPS (movie length: 00:00:30:00), recorded in 00:00:37 (81% of real-time speed).
CPU render time: 0.36 seconds (average: 0.20 ms/frame)
GPU render time: 6.37 seconds (average: 3.54 ms/frame)
Encoding time: 25.94 seconds (average: 14.41 ms/frame)
```

Taking an editor screenshot (which uses the standard PNG saving path) has unaffected file sizes and saving speeds regardless of this PR.

I still think we should take further steps to speed up lossless MovieWriter saving, but this can be done in other ways than https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/91263 if we don't want to go that route:

- Add internal (non-exposed) support to [write a basic uncompressed format like PPM](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/4751#issuecomment-1454772685). This should be even faster than QOI, at the cost of larger file sizes especially for animations with simpler colors (mostly 2D).
- [Use a ring buffer to keep GPU parallelization effective.](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/4751#issuecomment-1529306643)
- Investigate finding a way to make FFmpeg progressively accept frames as they're written for encoding (and remux audio together with video at the end of encoding), so that encoding can happen in parallel with frames being written.
Matches the design consensus from the core meeting.
